visual_brief.subject: Several pinned GPT-4 API snapshots and their fine-tuned descendants must cross one controlled migration boundary before a fixed shutdown
verified_context: OpenAI announced a January 14, 2027 API shutdown for listed GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, GPT-4.1, and GPT-4.1 mini snapshots.
Fine-tuned versions follow the shutdown schedule of their affected base models.
OpenAI recommends GPT-6 Luna as the replacement for every listed snapshot.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: A dated model retirement becomes a disciplined dependency migration when every pinned and inherited workload must pass through one tested boundary.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: Five weathered ceramic vessels move along separate shallow stone channels toward one precise brass gate, with one intact terracotta vessel waiting on the replacement path.

candidate_notes.A: Selected. Five visibly weathered vessels converge through one precise brass threshold toward a single intact terracotta successor; the migration relationship remains clear at thumbnail scale.
candidate_notes.B: Constitution-compliant. Calibration threads make inherited behavioral dependencies legible, but the fine brass detail becomes busy in a small crop.
candidate_notes.C: Constitution-compliant. Nested model stones clearly suggest fine-tuned descendants, but the archival transfer is less immediate than candidate A's deadline gate.

crop_review.article_desktop: All five source vessels, the brass gate, and the replacement vessel remain visible in the final 1600 x 900 crop.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered narrow crop preserves the gate, two representative aging vessels, and the replacement vessel.
crop_review.thumbnail: The many-to-one convergence and terracotta successor remain legible at 480 x 270.

golden_reference_comparison: The selected image carries the references' warm paper atmosphere, monumental geometric boundary, restrained terracotta and brass, physical depth, and quiet negative space while using a distinct migration-channel composition.
